title: How the Uruk Potters Used the Wheel. New Data on Modalities and Conditions of Emergence of the Potter's Wheel in the Uruk World
version: Interdisciplinaria Archaeologica: Natural Sciences in Archaeology XII(2), pp. 181–199

passages.quote: chronological coincidence with northern Mesopotamia – supported by archaeological evidence (Baldi, 2013; Vallet et al., 2017) indicating an adoption of wheel-coiling in the early 4th millennium (around 3900–3800 BCE)
4th millennium north-Mesopotamian and Uruk vessels were always wheel-coiled (rather than thrown), the use of these turntables capable of developing a limited speed and RKE is entirely plausible.
